Generate ONE finished premium photograph in a strict vertical 9:16 canvas, preferably 1080 × 1920 or 1152 × 2048. Edge-to-edge photographic artwork, not a mockup, grid, diptych or collage. An original adult person in a long cream coat stands on an empty misty seafront promenade at twilight, viewed from behind. Enormous translucent glowing jellyfish drift gently through the sky like living lanterns, with believable gelatin texture and delicate long tendrils suspended far above the person. Cinematic photorealistic fantasy, coral-pink and electric-blue bioluminescence, wet stone reflections, atmospheric depth. Highest photographic quality: crisp focal subject, natural fine texture, physically believable lighting and reflections within the surreal concept, sophisticated composition with vital subject inside the central 80% so Instagram controls do not hide it. No text, captions, typography, logos, watermarks, UI, frames or borders. Original fictional adults only when people appear; fully clothed. Avoid duplicated people, extra limbs, distorted hands, plastic skin, generic stock-photo styling. Compose specifically for 9:16, never square or landscape.
outputs.deliveryProcessing: Pillow ImageOps.fit with Lanczos to 1080x1920, WebP quality94; source images preserved unchanged. Export is resampled, not native 1080x1920 generation.
